observations: Roles 580–585 dispatch and construct trade fixtures using interior specifications, fixed board and frame widths, and solid or decorative members. Rack and workpiece geometry contains count-dependent division and normalized beam directions; the finite authored sizes narrow inputs but do not by themselves prove all derived values or downstream clearance behavior.

Role 584 source tests cover joined counter seams, selected trade envelopes and empty bins. The assertions were read only and never executed; they do not establish that every furnishing, placement or consumer passes.

Role 586 constructs a surface of revolution from successive profile pairs and terminal caps. It indexes the first and last profile elements and passes cap vertices with the same initial order and opposite normals. Empty or zero-radius profiles require caller tracing before a failure claim; the triangle insertion function may adjust winding and must be inspected before treating initial order as final order.

Role 587 constructs four worship fittings, uses a separately represented font profile and collision proxies, and ignores zero-normal font triangles. Intended empty interiors and visible/physical approximations require actual consumers and design policy, not an assumption that every proxy is a defect.
Role 588 is the generator module root with many included files and modules. Only the root was read and credited: none of those bodies was implicitly assessed by reading its include declarations.
No furniture recipe, product build, test, simulation, rendering or runtime probe ran.
remaining: Trace turned-profile producers, triangle insertion, material consumers, placement authority, the generator included bodies, all historical aliases and all independent lenses.
